title: fix(mcp): agent_prompt reads agents through the protocol read GET /meta/agent/NAME serves
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XBK9EgGPfyQH8cn35jeTJe3)_

domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kNHZKmo4BTWcwTdNs

Fixes #31514

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP stdio 服务器的 `agent_prompt` 现在通过协议层的按名读取(就是 `GET /api/v1/meta/agent/NAME` 用的那个 `getMetaItem`)取 agent;决定是否列出 `agent_prompt` 的 agent 名单也改读协议的合并列表(`GET /api/v1/meta/agent` 用的 `getMetaItems`)。没有协议服务的宿主照旧读内核 metadata 服务,每个宿主只有一个读者:用协议还是用 metadata 服务,由新的 `agentReadOf` 按宿主一次决定(两种读取都有才用协议),名单和按名读取都用这一个决定。
- 为什么改:包里自带的 agent 只在协议读取的注册表里,内核 metadata 服务没有它的副本。以前 MCP 读 metadata 服务,所以只装了包内 agent 的环境根本不列出 `agent_prompt`,也取不到这个 agent,而 `/meta/agent/NAME` 能取到。两个“按名取 agent”的入口答案不一致。
- 风险与回滚:环境自己的 agent 照旧可用;找不到时仍回答 `Error: Agent "X" not found`;协议读取报 503 时仍是原来的不可用提示、不给指令。`McpMergedMetadataRead` 类型多了一个可选成员 `getMetaItem`(公开类型放宽)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` 的 `agentReadOf`(新,唯一的决定)、`readAgentByName`(新)、`buildAgentPromptResult` 里改用它的一行、`readAgentRoster` 改读 `mergedDiagnosedList`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-server-runtime.agent-prompt-advertised.test.ts -t "one reader with GET"`,预期 8 个用例通过:只有包内 agent 时列出 `agent_prompt`、取到的指令与协议按名读取一致、环境 agent 照旧、未知名字照旧报未找到、503 照旧报不可用、只有列表没有按名读取的宿主两边都读 metadata 服务、其他异常照旧抛出、协议在场时名单降级照旧列出。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`, the long-lived (stdio) server's prompt bridge:

- **`agentReadOf` (new, module-private): the one decision per host.** It answers the host's read when that read carries both the merged listing (`getMetaItems`) and the by-name read (`getMetaItem`), and `undefined` (the metadata service) otherwise. The roster and the get both take this one answer, so a host whose read has the listing but no by-name read reads the metadata service for both, rather than advertising a package agent that the get answers "not found" (the #28940 defect again; contract review should-fix). `bridgePrompts` computes it once as `agentRead` and passes it to both.
- **`readAgentByName` (new, module-private).** Where `agentReadOf` picks the host's `mergedRead` (the `protocol` service, which `plugin.ts` already hands `bridgePrompts`) carries a by-name read, the agent is read through `getMetaItem({ type: 'agent', name })`, the read `GET /api/v1/meta/agent/NAME` serves, and its `item` is the agent. A throw coded `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (the protocol's 503 when the metadata service behind it could not be read and nothing resolved) is the #6055 outage; any other throw travels, as a throw of the metadata service's read always did. Where it picks the metadata service, its `getDiagnosed`/`get` is read exactly as before. One reader per host, never a lookup that tries both (order ruling).
- **`buildAgentPromptResult`** takes the protocol as an optional fourth argument and reads through `readAgentByName`. Its three answers are unchanged: the instructions plus any UI context; `Error: Agent "X" not found` on a miss; the `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` sentence on an outage, with no instructions.
- **`readAgentRoster` (#28940)** reads `mergedDiagnosedList(metadataService, agentReadOf(mergedRead), 'agent')`: the protocol's merged listing, `GET /api/v1/meta/agent`'s read, with the metadata service's `listDiagnosed` completeness verdict on top, the composition the skill listing already uses. It missed package-shipped agents too (measured below), so per the ruling it moves to the same reader; a boot whose only agent a package ships now advertises `agent_prompt` and names that agent in the argument description.
- **`McpMergedMetadataRead`** gains an optional `getMetaItem(request)` member. It is the type of `MCPServerRuntime.bridgePrompts`' second parameter, so it is in the published `index.d.ts`; that is why `Clause-②` reads `yes (widening)`. No `plugin.ts` change: the object it passes is the `protocol` service, which has both reads.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/31514-agent-prompt-protocol-read.md`: `@objectstack/mcp` patch, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Naming is the bare name `/meta/agent/NAME` serves today; nothing here anticipates #31527's package-scoped address.

## Tests

**Unit, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.agent-prompt-advertised.test.ts`** (the existing `agent_prompt` harness, a new top-level `describe`, driven over the real MCP wire with an in-memory transport). The metadata double holds no copy of the package agent; the protocol double serves it through `getMetaItems` and `getMetaItem`.

1. A boot whose only agent a package ships lists `agent_prompt`, and the `agentName` description names `"pkg_helper"`.
2. `prompts/get` serves exactly the instructions the protocol's `getMetaItem({ type: 'agent', name })` answers; the metadata double is never asked for that agent.
3. CONTROL: an environment agent is listed and served as before (with its UI context line).
4. An unknown name answers `[{ role: 'user', content: { type: 'text', text: 'Error: Agent "nope" not found' } }]`, today's miss.
5. A by-name read thrown `{ code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', status: 503 }` answers one `user` message starting `Error: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE — `, carrying no instructions, and warns `agent prompt refused`.
6. A host whose read is `{ getMetaItems }` only (no `getMetaItem`) reads the metadata service for both: the argument names the environment agent `"support_triage"` and not `pkg_helper`, the listing is never asked for `agent`, and the environment agent is served as before.
7. A by-name read thrown with any other code (`INTERNAL`) rejects `prompts/get` with that error, serves no instructions, and does not warn `agent prompt refused`.
8. With the protocol present, a degraded roster verdict and no agent named keeps the prompt listed with no example, and warns with the verdict's errors.

**Real kernel, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/mcp-stdio-package-object-discovery.test.ts`** (the existing MCP stdio package-discovery harness, a new top-level `describe` per boot shape and registration). A package that ships one agent and no object is registered through the `manifest` service on a real `ObjectKernel` with `MetadataPlugin` + `ObjectQLPlugin`, and the real `MCPServerPlugin` stdio server is driven over JSON-RPC. On all four rows (`env_local` and no `environmentId`, registered during the boot and installed after it): `prompts/list` advertises `agent_prompt` naming the package agent, and `prompts/get` serves the instructions the kernel's own `protocol.getMetaItem({ type: 'agent', name })` answers; a miss keeps its answer. The `boot` helper's `pkg` parameter is narrowed to `{ artifact(): unknown }`, its only use, and `Booted` gains `rpc`.

<details><summary>Red first, on main dabef0f6 (cases 1–5) and on 959a0c61 (cases 6–8)</summary>

- Unit: 4 failed, 9 passed. Case 1 `expected [ 'case_management' ] to include 'agent_prompt'`; cases 2, 4, 5 `MCP error -32602: Prompt agent_prompt not found` (the prompt was never advertised). The control passed.
- Dogfood: 8 failed, 80 passed, all four rows. In every row the test's first assertion, that the kernel's `protocol.getMetaItem` serves the package agent's instructions, passed; then `prompts/get` and `prompts/list` answered `-32601 Method not found`: with no agent in the roster and no skill, the server advertised no prompts at all.
- Cases 6–8, added after the contract review on 959a0c61: case 6 red (`expected 'Name of the agent to load (e.g. "pkg_…' to contain '"support_triage"'`: the roster read the protocol listing while the get stayed on the metadata service); 7 and 8 green there, as they pin behaviour 959a0c61 already had (their ablations below show they can go red).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs on committed heads 2946313b and 9d09636b; unit tests import sources, no dist on the path; each restored with blob == HEAD and an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

- **The get read back on the metadata service.** In `buildAgentPromptResult`, `readAgentByName(metadataService, protocol, agentName)` → `diagnosedGet(metadataService, 'agent', agentName)`. Case 2 goes red (`expected [ { role: 'user', … } ] to deeply equal [ { role: 'assistant', … } ]`: the package agent answered "not found"), and case 5. Cases 1, 3, 4 stay green. Restored.
- **The roster back on the metadata service.** In `readAgentRoster`, `mergedDiagnosedList(metadataService, mergedRead, 'agent')` → `diagnosedList(metadataService, 'agent')`. Cases 1, 2, 4, 5 go red (the prompt is not advertised); the control stays green. Restored.
- **The shared gate split again (9d09636b).** In `agentReadOf`, the `&& typeof mergedRead.getMetaItem === 'function'` clause deleted. Case 6 goes red (`expected 'Name of the agent to load (e.g. "pkg_…' to contain '"support_triage"'`); the other 15 stay green. Restored.
- **Every by-name throw read as an outage (9d09636b).** In `readAgentByName`, the `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` test and `throw err` replaced by an unconditional degraded answer. Case 7 goes red (`promise resolved "{ messages: [ { role: 'user', …(1) } ] }" instead of rejecting`). Restored.
- **A degraded roster read as complete (9d09636b).** In `readAgentRoster`, `if (read.degraded) return { state: 'unknown', errors: read.errors };` deleted. Case 8 goes red, and the existing metadata-only degraded pin with it. Restored.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The HTTP surface (`/api/v1/mcp`) has no `agent_prompt`.** Its per-request server bridges skill prompts only (`buildMcpBridge` in `packages/runtime`), so this PR has no second surface to point.
- **Degraded roster.** The roster's completeness verdict is still the metadata service's `listDiagnosed`, as for skill prompts (#8328): a degraded verdict with no agent named keeps the prompt listed with no example, as before (case 8 pins it with the protocol present).
- **Governed surface.** None of the four paths is in the register (`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`, see Verification).
- **Branch.** The harness branch was restarted from `origin/main` after #31464 merged; its remote had been deleted on merge, so the first push created it fresh and no force push was needed.

## Verification

All readings are on head `863aa0f5`: the fix commits `2946313b` and `9d09636b` (the review's should-fix), with `origin/main` merged three times, never rebased (`959a0c61`, `72b76773`, `863aa0f5`; none of the merged commits touches `packages/mcp` or `packages/qa/dogfood`). Each exit code is captured before any pipe.

- **mcp suite**: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test` (through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`) exit 0 on `72b76773`, Tests 915 passed (915); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run` exit 0 again on `863aa0f5`, Tests 915 passed (915).
- **dogfood file**: after `pnpm --filter "@objectstack/dogfood^..." build` (exit 0), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/mcp-stdio-package-object-discovery.test.ts`, exit 0, Tests 88 passed (88), on `72b76773`.
- **Typecheck**: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`, exit 0; the test layer holds at its recorded debt (6 files, 53 errors, 8 pinned signatures, none new). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`, exit 0.
- **Lint**: `eslint packages/mcp packages/qa/dogfood/test/mcp-stdio-package-object-discovery.test.ts --no-inline-config` (scoped to the touched paths), exit 0.
- **i18n**: `pnpm check:i18n-coverage`, exit 0 after the last merge.
- **Derived gate union**: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 67 families on `72b76773`, all 67 exit 0 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` included); the last merge added one family, `check:adr-symbol-anchors`, run on `863aa0f5`, exit 0. `--ran`: "68 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- **Governed surface**: `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`, exit 0, "NOT governed"; 395 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold.

The `test:repo` project and `Test Core` shards are CI's and this PR's check-runs carry them. The dogfood shards are skipped on `pull_request` and run only in the merge queue, so the PR's check-runs do not cover the dogfood file; the local run above does.

- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (scoped to the touched paths)

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is the lane's required Chinese summary)
